buildCommand: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b 3.29.3 --depth 1 flutter-sdk && export PATH="$PATH:$(pwd)/flutter-sdk/bin" && flutter config --no-analytics && flutter pub get && export BUILD_TIME=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") && flutter build web --release --base-href / --dart-define=API_URL=$API_URL --dart-define=GIT_HASH=$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA --dart-define=BUILD_TIME=$BUILD_TIME
